_note: Benchmark text inputs for the describe-meal arm (2026-07 model-quality benchmark). Written to sound like an athlete recording a meal, not clean lab prompts. 10 long (detailed/chatty) + 10 short (terse quick-logs), spread across breakfast / lunch / dinner / snack and endurance-fueling moments. Vary on purpose: some exact grams/brands, some vague ('a big bowl', 'a handful'), some with self-corrections.

long.text: Big bowl of oatmeal this morning before my run — about a cup of rolled oats cooked in water, then I stirred in a sliced banana, a heaping spoonful of peanut butter, a handful of blueberries and a drizzle of honey. Washed it down with a large black coffee.

Grabbed a burrito bowl at Chipotle for lunch — brown rice, black beans, double chicken, the fajita veggies, a scoop of corn salsa, cheese and a bit of guac. Skipped the sour cream. Ate the whole thing, I was starving after this morning.
Made salmon for dinner, maybe a 6 oz fillet, baked with a little olive oil and lemon. Had it with one medium roasted sweet potato and a big pile of roasted broccoli. Glass of white wine on the side.
Post-workout recovery shake — one scoop of vanilla whey blended with oat milk, a frozen banana and a spoon of almond butter. Pretty filling, I'd guess somewhere around 400 calories?
Kept breakfast simple and carby before my long ride so my stomach wouldn't fight me — two slices of white toast with jam and honey, a banana, and a coffee with a splash of milk.
Turkey sandwich for lunch — two slices of whole wheat, a few slices of deli turkey, lettuce, tomato, a little mayo and mustard. Had it with an apple and a small handful of pretzels.
Carb loading before tomorrow's race so I went big — a huge bowl of spaghetti with marinara and some ground turkey mixed in, a couple pieces of garlic bread, and a side salad with italian dressing.

Weekend breakfast, made a veggie omelette with three eggs, spinach, mushrooms and a bit of feta, cooked in olive oil. On the side I had two slices of sourdough and half an avocado, plus a small orange juice.

Fueling on the bike — over the last hour I got through two Maurten gels and about half a Clif bar, and I've been sipping a bottle of Skratch the whole ride. Roughly, anyway, hard to track exactly while riding.
Ordered Thai takeout — chicken pad thai, a pretty big portion, and we split some spring rolls. I'd say I ate about two-thirds of the pad thai and two of the spring rolls.

short.text: oatmeal w/ banana and peanut butter, black coffee
chipotle chicken bowl — brown rice, black beans, guac
grilled chicken breast, white rice, steamed green beans
vanilla protein shake with a banana
turkey sandwich, apple, handful of pretzels
greek yogurt with granola and blueberries
handful of almonds and an apple
